body.x: PLATFORMBASE participated in the world’slargest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 toshowcase its ICT-based small digital lock.

PLATFORMBASE specializes in locking-basedphysical security solutions and has a converged technology and business model.The technology holds a number of nationally recognized New Excellent Technology(NET) Certification and patents in Korea, the US, Europe and China. The companyalso received Prime Minister’s citation and MOTIE minister citation.

PLATFORMBASE’s digital lock system has thesame size as the regular mechanical locks, eliminating installationrestrictions, and ICT functions are applied to solve security, management,convenience and control functions.

Its size is small compared to regularmechanical locks, so it can be sued widely. Since there is no battery in thelock, there is no risk of explosion and it can be used in the main facilitystorage. In addition, it is an eco-friendly product that reduces the cost andmanagement process of battery replacement and eliminates waste of battery. Theusage history is stored, and multiple locks can be used with a single key tofacilitate management tasks, and the control system can be built with thereal-time communication function to remotely monitor usage and authorizeaccess.

The official said, “We have entered theEuropean market with clear standards for security, safety, and management, andestablished a foothold in the Asian market based on the Korean and Japanesemarkets. With participating in CES, we have made the first step to enter the USmarket.”

He added, “Our partner is a specialist withcapabilities in security/system/sales in each country. We will reinforcemarketing to attract new customers as well as existing customers and make morereference through domestic and overseas specialized companies.”

The world’s largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global consumer electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January. AVING NEWS has reported the most news on CES, MWC, and IFA, the world's three major tech exhibitions for the past 13 years. It is sending special reporters to CES this year to report major issues in the global market and introduce outstanding Korean companies to the world.
